title: Zeroed Buffer
prompt: Implement `int* zero_buffer(int n)`: heap array of n ints where EVERY element is 0 (n >= 1 guaranteed). Return NULL if allocation fails.

tests.name: zeros then sentinel
tests.hint: calloc zeroes everything; then set the LAST element to 1.

tests.name: single
tests.hint: n=1: the only element is the sentinel.
